title: Claude Code boosts AI power with five MCPs for browsing #claudecode #mcpintegration #aitechnology
description: Claude Code gained five MCPs that drastically expand its capabilities, making it ten times more powerful. These include Perplexity MCP for live internet access, Playwright MCP for real browser control and testing, Firecrawl MCP for comprehensive website crawling, Glyph MCP for connecting to multiple image and video models with prompt writing, and Chrome MCP to read active browser tabs. These enhancements transform Claude Code from a static AI model into a dynamic, interactive tool that can access live data, automate web interactions, process visual content, and integrate seamlessly with user environments. This shift enables more accurate, real-time responses and broadens use cases in automation, testing, content generation, and data gathering. The consolidation of these MCPs reflects a trend toward modular AI systems that extend the functionality of core models through specialized plugins, creating versatile platforms with improved user control and efficiency. #ClaudeCode #PerplexityMCP #PlaywrightMCP #FirecrawlMCP #GlyphMCP #ChromeMCP #AIplugins #ArtificialIntelligence #AIAutomation #MachineLearning #WebAutomation #ContentGeneration #DataCrawling #OpenAIIntegrations #AIModularity
